rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: H2–O2 fuel cell reactions: anode H2 + 2OH− → 2H2O + 2e; cathode O2 + 2H2O + 4e → 4OH−; overall 2H2 + O2 → 2H2O; E ≈ 1.23 V.  ·  Trick 2: Efficiency ~70% (not Carnot-limited) vs thermal plants ~40% — the efficiency contrast is the standard 2-mark answer.
